responsibility: Implements REAL formatting into DynamicStrings using dtoa plus shared string-construction utilities. It performs significant-figure rounding, decimal-point placement, engineering-format scaling to powers of three, fixed-point rendering, and sign/exponent text assembly, providing the formatted string results used by higher-level real conversion and I/O modules.
same_name_distinction: This is the REAL formatting implementation for the ConvStringReal interface: unlike ConvStringReal.def, it contains the formatting logic and uses dtoa for single-precision conversion, whereas the same-pattern ConvStringLong.mod handles LONGREAL with ldtoa.
